title: An efficient pulsed-field gel electrophoresis method for typing Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus strains
author: Heikkinen, von Wright, et al.
materials: de Man, Rogosa and Sharpe (MRS) broth (Neogen)
de Man, Rogosa and Sharpe (MRS) agar (Neogen)

The sectioned agarose blocks were loaded into the wells of a pulsed-field agarose gel (Bio-Rad Certified Megabase agarose, 1.0% w/v, prepared in 0.5 x TBE buffer) and subjected to transverse alternating field electrophoresis using 0.5 x TBE buffer containing thiourea (0.4 mM) and using the following parameters: 5 V/cm; switch time, 3.5–25 s for 16 h, followed by 1–5 s for 8 h at 14°C. MidRange PFG Size Marker 15–291 kb (New England Biolabs) was included for each run.

steps.title: Culture L. rhamnosus strains
steps.instruction: Inoculate each subsample (industrial batches BO542740, BO543269, BO543270, pure IMI 507023, and reference DSM 20021) into MRS broth and incubate anaerobically at 30 °C for 24 h; then subculture onto MRS agar and incubate under the same conditions for 48 h.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension and heat treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer colonies from MRS agar into 5 mL ice‑cold 100 mM EDTA buffer, adjust turbidity to A₆₂₅ = 1.3 ± 0.2, heat‑treat at 75 °C for 10 min, aliquot 3.5 mL into a 10 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge at 1800 rcf for 5 min, discard supernatant, wash cells with 10 mL 100 mM EDTA, and finally resuspend the pellet in 600 µL 100 mM EDTA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer colonies to 5 mL ice‑cold 100 mM EDTA buffer.
Aliquot 3.5 mL into a new 10 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge 1800 rcf, 5 min.
Discard supernatant, wash cells with 10 mL 100 mM EDTA.
Resuspend cells in 600 µL 100 mM EDTA buffer.

steps.title: Enzymatic cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL lysozyme stock (150 mg/mL in 100 mM EDTA) and 12.5 µL mutanolysin (1000 U/mL in 100 mM EDTA) to the cell suspension, incubate at 50 °C for 15 min, then add 20 µL proteinase K stock (20 mg/mL in 100 mM EDTA).

substeps.instruction: Add lysozyme and mutanolysin to the suspension.

steps.title: Embed cells in agarose plugs
steps.instruction: Mix 300 µL of the lysed cell suspension with 300 µL of 2 % (w/v) low‑melting‑point agarose prepared in 0.5 × TBE (0.9 M boric acid, 0.01 M EDTA, pH 8.4), pipette into a pre‑cooled plug mold avoiding bubbles, and refrigerate at 4 ± 1 °C for 20 min.

substeps.instruction: Prepare equal‑volume mixture of lysed suspension and 2 % low‑melting‑point agarose in 0.5 × TBE.
Transfer mixture to pre‑cooled plug mold, avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Digest plugs with sarcosyl and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Immerse each agarose plug in 5 mL 1 % (w/v) N‑lauroylsarcosine sodium (sarcosyl) prepared in 100 mM EDTA inside a 50 mL Falcon tube, add 25 µL proteinase K stock (20 mg/mL), seal with a screen plug cap, and incubate at 55 °C for 2 h.

substeps.instruction: Place plugs in 5 mL sarcosyl solution (1 % w/v in 100 mM EDTA).
Seal tubes and incubate at 55 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Wash and store agarose plugs
steps.instruction: Wash plugs twice with 5 mL sterile water containing PMSF (0.175 mg/mL) for 15 min each at room temperature, then wash six times with 5 mL 100 mM EDTA (15 min each, RT), and finally store plugs in 2 mL 100 mM EDTA at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2 ×  with 5 mL sterile water + 0.175 mg/mL PMSF (15 min each).
Wash 6 ×  with 5 mL 100 mM EDTA (15 min each).
Store plugs in 2 mL 100 mM EDTA at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PFGE gel and running buffer
steps.instruction: Cast a 1.0 % (w/v) Bio‑Rad Certified Megabase agarose gel in 0.5 × TBE, and prepare the electrophoresis running buffer as 0.5 × TBE containing 0.4 mM thiourea; load the agarose plugs into the wells.

steps.title: Run pulsed‑field gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 5 V/cm, 14 °C, using a switch time program of 3.5–25 s for 16 h followed by 1–5 s for 8 h, and include the MidRange PFG Size Marker (15–291 kb, New England Biolabs) in each run.

steps.title: Analyze PFGE images and compute similarity
steps.instruction: Photograph the gel and process the image with Bionumerics 8.0 (pre‑processing, lane detection, normalization, band detection); perform automatic band detection then manual adjustment, discard bands < 15 kb, calculate Dice coefficients, cluster with UPGMA, using tolerance 1.0 % and optimization 0.5 %; consider isolates identical when Dice similarity ≥ 90 %.
